events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of American-British singer, songwriter, and The Pretenders frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75.

angles.name: Voice of a generation
angles.copy: Chrissie Hynde, the unmistakable voice of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today. What's your favourite track from the rock icon?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the iconic English singer-songwriter, Liam Gallagher, known as the frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Liam Gallagher, the legendary voice of Oasis, is celebrating his birthday. What's your top tune from the Manchester icon?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the release of John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' in the UK in 1975, though the album and US single were released in 1971.

angles.name: A timeless message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since the album and over 50 since the US single, John Lennon's 'Imagine' saw its UK single release in 1975. Its message of peace and unity remains as powerful today.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the 1962 release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Today marks the anniversary of 'Dr. No's' release back in '62. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: A legend's legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the 87th birthday of legendary English actor, comedian, and writer, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy genius
angles.copy: The one and only John Cleese is celebrating his 87th birthday today! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: The show must go on
angles.copy: Today marks 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A turning point
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Widely seen as a pivotal album, it showcased their evolving sound and lyrical depth. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Marking the 46th anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: His lasting impact
angles.copy: Today, we remember John Lennon, 46 years since his untimely death. His legacy of music, peace, and love continues to resonate globally.
